description: Cue vocabulary of the benign-lookalike veto (#721). Any cue word or any letter outside the Latin ranges anywhere in a document disables every veto. The agentic-layer generator checks its labelled cells (A) and counterweights (D) against this file; the Rust veto test asserts its own lists equal these, order included. Matching: words split at every non-letter and at each lower-to-upper case change; lowercased and accent-folded; a word is a cue when it starts with a stem or equals a whole word.
